      "Groundwater lateral flow and regional aquifer dynamics (would require coupled PFLOTRAN 3D domain)",
      "Human water withdrawals, reservoir operations, or diversions"

  "n_columns": 2,
  "n_justification": "Two columns representing the dominant landscape/soil settings of the Salt River headwaters (a montane forested upland on sandy loam and a lower semi-arid slope on loam/clay-loam) so that partitioning contrasts are not tied to a single soil assumption; both columns are run over the full 1993 and 2002 periods to enable the wet/dry contrast.",

answerable: Contrast of annual and seasonal water partitioning (ET vs. runoff vs. drainage vs. soil-moisture storage change) between 1993 (wet) and 2002 (dry)
Relative fractions of evapotranspiration components (canopy transpiration, canopy evaporation, ground/soil evaporation)
Surface runoff vs. subsurface drainage response to precipitation forcing
Snow accumulation/melt contribution to the water budget in each year
Soil moisture and water-table depth differences between the two years
not_answerable: Lateral/streamflow routing to the actual Salt River gauge (single-column ELM has no lateral routing)
Spatially distributed basin-scale discharge or hydrograph timing
Groundwater lateral flow and regional aquifer dynamics (would require coupled PFLOTRAN 3D domain)
Human water withdrawals, reservoir operations, or diversions

parsed.n_justification: Two columns representing the dominant landscape/soil settings of the Salt River headwaters (a montane forested upland on sandy loam and a lower semi-arid slope on loam/clay-loam) so that partitioning contrasts are not tied to a single soil assumption; both columns are run over the full 1993 and 2002 periods to enable the wet/dry contrast.
requires_capabilities: GSWP3 or CRUNCEP atmospheric forcing spanning 1985-2002 for the site
surface dataset with site-specific PFT and soil texture (sandy loam / clay loam)
ELM default subsurface hydrology (no lateral routing needed)
assumptions: 1993 is treated as the wet (above-average precipitation, strong winter/spring snowpack) year and 2002 as the dry (severe drought) year for the Salt River headwaters, consistent with regional records.
1985-1992 is used as model spinup/equilibration; analysis focuses on the 1993 and 2002 water years.
Column locations approximate the White Mountains / upper Black-White River headwater region of the Salt River basin.
PFT set defaults to mixed conifer/needleleaf evergreen forest for the upland column and shrub/grass for the lower semi-arid column.
Monthly-to-annual output resolution is sufficient for partitioning contrast; daily history could be added if event-scale analysis is required.
No irrigation, groundwater pumping, or reservoir influence is represented.
